name: annotations-extensibility
description: Customize annotation mode for your website in the ChatGPT browser: choose what users can select, add context to comments, and offer controls that preview changes.

interface.shortDescription: Customize how annotation mode interacts with your site.
interface.longDescription: Customize what happens when someone uses annotation mode on your website in the ChatGPT browser. Choose which parts of the page they can select, add useful context to their comments, and offer controls that preview changes such as color, size, or visibility. Use public documentation to integrate page selection, custom controls, and canvas objects through your existing application code.
defaultPrompt: Customize annotation mode for my website in the ChatGPT browser.
Add custom controls to this website's annotation editor.
Explain how my website can customize annotation mode.
